hero.paragraph: Kuva ku muzigo umwe w'ihutirwa kugeza ku mategeko magana ku munsi, dore uko dufasha ibintu byawe kugera aho bigomba kugera — ku gihe, kandi bizwi neza.

services.title: Urutonde runini rw'Ubucuruzi (B2B)
services.shortDesc: Uburyo bwikoresha bwo kohereza ku bacuruzi benshi.
services.description: Ohereza urutonde rwawe rwa buri munsi ukoresheje CSV cyangwa API, maze turebere ibisigaye — ibicuruzwa bikohererezwa mu buryo bwikoresha, bikagabanywa, kandi bikagenerwa abakozi bacu. Byakorewe uruganda rw'ubucuruzi kuri interineti, abasaba ibicuruzwa, n'abafatanyabikorwa binini bakohereza amagana y'imizigo ku munsi.

services.title: Umukozi Uboneka Igihe Ushaka
services.shortDesc: Kohereza umuzigo umwe vuba hirya no hino i Kigali.
services.description: Igihe bigomba kugera ubu nonaha. Saba umukozi binyuze kuri urubuga rwacu cyangwa WhatsApp, tugafata no gutanga ibicuruzwa inzu ku nzu, nta gihe cyo kubika mu bubiko. Byiza ku nyandiko z'ihutirwa, itumiza rimwe mu bucuruzi, no ku bice by'ihutirwa.

specs.label: Gukurikirana
specs.value: Ihuza rya GPS mu Gihe Nyacyo

services.title: Kwishyura Igihe cyo Gutanga
services.shortDesc: Gukusanya amafaranga mu buryo bwizewe, agatangwa ku gihe.
services.description: Kwishyura igihe cyo gutanga bikomeza ubucuruzi bw'aho iwacu, ariko gukurikirana kwishyura bigabanya umuvuduko wawe. Turinda amafaranga yawe ako kanya umuzigo utanzwe — buri gukusanya kwanditswe mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga, kandi amafaranga yose akohererezwa kuri konti yawe ya banki cyangwa mobile money mu masaha 48.

services.title: Ubwikorezi mu Ntara
services.description: Gura isoko ryawe nta kugira umuparata wawe bwite. Dukora ingendo ziteganyijwe zerekeza ku bigo binini by'intara mu gihugu hose kandi dutegura ubwikorezi bwizewe bunyura ku mipaka bujya mu masoko ari hafi nka DRC na Uganda.

cta.heading: Ntabwo uzi serivisi ikwiye?
cta.paragraph: Tubwire umubare w'ibicuruzwa utanga maze tugufashe kubona uburyo bukwiye — nta gufatwa ku ngufu, nta magambo agoye.
